title: Sign up as a teacher
lead: All you need is your WhatsApp number and a password. Your name, school and subjects can be added later in your account.

point.classes: Create classes; students join with a code
point.ktp: Upload your КТП and get ready lesson plans

trialNote: After you sign up, a free trial opens. Choose your subjects and grades in your account.

phone.title: Your WhatsApp number
phone.lead: We will send a 6-digit code to WhatsApp on this number.
phone.label: WhatsApp number
phone.hint: 9 digits after +996 — the number your WhatsApp is on

code.title: Enter the code from WhatsApp
code.sent: We sent a 6-digit code to WhatsApp on {{phone}}.
code.label: The {{n}}-digit code from WhatsApp
code.incomplete: Enter all {{n}} digits of the code
code.wrong: Wrong code. Check the WhatsApp message and try again
code.expired: This code has expired. Get a new one
code.help: The code comes as a WhatsApp message to this number. Make sure WhatsApp is installed on it.
code.wait: You can get a new code in {{time}}
code.resendReady: You can get a new code now
code.resent: A new code has been sent to WhatsApp

password.title: Create a password
password.lead: You will sign in with your number and this password.
password.label: Password
password.hint: At least {{n}} characters. A phrase of a few words is easy to remember.

strength.short: Too short: use at least {{n}} characters
strength.fair: Good enough. Longer is even safer

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.lead: Confirm your WhatsApp number and choose a new password.

point.code: A code comes to your WhatsApp

reset.staffNote: Staff accounts with an e-mail: ask your school administrator to reset the password.
reset.phoneLead: We will send a 6-digit code to WhatsApp on this number.
reset.passwordLead: After saving, you are signed in and other devices are signed out.

taken.title: This number is already registered
taken.text: {{phone}} already has a Bilig account. Sign in, or reset the password if you have forgotten it.

error.phoneInvalid: This does not look like a Kyrgyz mobile number. Check it
error.passwordShort: The password must be at least {{n}} characters

weak.leaked: This password appears in lists of leaked passwords. Please choose another one
weak.too_short: The password must be at least {{n}} characters
weak.too_simple: The password is too simple or contains your number
weak.other: This password is not strong enough. Please choose another one

error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a little
error.offline: No internet connection. Check it and try again
